## Methodology note
1. **Price:** latest daily adjusted close from Yahoo Finance.
2. **SMA150:** 150-day simple moving average of close.
3. **Slope:** OLS slope of the SMA150 series vs trading-day index over the last ~140 available SMA150 points (positive = rising 150-day MA).
4. **Stages:** Stage 2 if price > SMA150 and slope > 0; Stage 4 if price < SMA150 and slope < 0; Stage 3 (Topping) if price > SMA150 and slope ≤ 0; Stage 1 (Basing) if price < SMA150 and slope ≥ 0.
5. **Action:** Stage 2 → BUY / HOLD; Stage 4 → SELL / AVOID; else HOLD / WATCH.
6. **Volume confirmation:** Stage 2 and latest volume > 1.3 × 50-day average volume.
7. **Extended %:** (price − SMA50) / SMA50 (SMA50 ≈ spreadsheet 10-week MA).
8. **Score:** Stage 2 base + normalized slope strength + volume confirmation + preference for extended_pct under ~0.25.
